name: Précis Translator
tagline: Translate real PDF and Office documents while preserving the structure, formatting and user-visible layout that make them usable.
problem: A translated file is often useless when its typography, tables, slides, positioning and page flow are damaged. Generic text-only translation discards the constraints and visual identity of the original PDF or Office document.
scenario: A user selects a PDF, DOCX, PPTX or XLSX. A format-specific engine extracts translatable content with layout context, translates it using a bounded provider integration and reinjects the result into the original document structure for preview and download.
differentiation: Précis separates API, services and document engines so geometry-sensitive transformations can be tested independently, PDF and slides may render progressively, and translation or font changes invalidate versioned preview caches.
architecture: React/Vite user interface -> FastAPI routes -> services/job workers -> versioned PDF, PPTX, DOCX and XLSX engines -> translation provider. Engines are isolated from application state; SSE reports job progress and previews while blocking work stays outside the async event loop.
limitations: Digital PDF and Office format handling does not establish universal pixel-perfect equivalence or verified OCR support for scanned pages. The OCR study is a design reference, not proof of a delivered scan translation engine; deployment, billing, provider access and practical document regression cases need independent validation.

capabilities.name: Format-aware engines
capabilities.description: Implement dedicated PDF, PPTX, DOCX and XLSX translation paths with versioned rendering logic.

capabilities.name: Progressive previews
capabilities.description: Document streaming previews for supported progressively rendered PDF and slide operations.

capabilities.name: Scanned-document OCR
capabilities.description: Study OCR layout extraction and image-safe reinjection without treating this research as a production feature.

capabilities.name: Production readiness
capabilities.description: Verify deployment, end-to-end translated file acceptance and provider-dependent operations.

roadmap.name: Runtime acceptance
roadmap.exitCriteria: Demonstrate representative format round trips, failure behavior, job isolation and readable final rendered documents.

roadmap.name: Release verification
roadmap.exitCriteria: Complete the documented deployment checklist with observable customer-flow evidence for the selected release.

roadmap.name: Scan translation research
roadmap.exitCriteria: Prove OCR extraction and selective image reinjection on synthetic ground-truth scans before advertising scan support.

references.name: Product architecture
references.relevance: Documents the isolated format engines, progressive delivery and transformation boundaries.

references.name: AppFactory README assurance
references.relevance: Non-destructive presentation and evidence-based maturity validation.

presentation.headline: La traduction, sans sacrifier la mise en page.
presentation.summary: Traduire PDF et documents Office avec des moteurs adaptés à chaque format, des aperçus progressifs et une architecture qui respecte le document d'origine.
